svg.title: Prompt Caching Across Requests
svg.desc: Sequence between a client and the Claude API. A static prefix (system prompt, tool definitions, examples) ends at a cache_control breakpoint. Request 1 sends the static prefix plus user query A; the response is a cache miss on the prefix, with full processing and a cache write. Request 2 sends the static prefix plus user query B; the response is a cache hit on the prefix, reused, cheap and fast. Request 3 sends the static prefix plus user query C; the response is a cache hit, with the prefix reused again within the TTL.
svg.text: Put the static prefix before the cache breakpoint; only the user query changes per request.
system prompt, tool defs, examples, ending at a cache_control breakpoint
